Quine Exporter
Net: Local

Quine & Native App Exporter

This module represents a computer science Quine—a program that outputs and downloads its own running source code to run 100% offline as a standalone desktop utility.

Self-Contained Quine

Downloads a complete snapshot of the running DOM including all styling, layouts, scripts, and initial assets. You can double-click this file on any machine to run OmniPortal completely offline!

Native Desktop Exporter

Convert your downloaded standalone HTML file into a native double-clickable desktop executable (`.exe`, `.app`, or binary) for Windows, macOS, or Linux.

Quick Instructions:
  1. Download the HTML file using the button above.
  2. Download the packager.js script below.
  3. Place both in a folder and run the terminal commands:
npm install electron electron-packager && node packager.js

 * OmniPortal Native desktop application packager.
 * Runs in Node.js to bundle your downloaded HTML file.
 * 
 * Instructions:
 * 1. Put this script and 'OmniPortal-Quine-Workspace.html' in the same folder.
 * 2. Run: npm install electron electron-packager
 * 3. Run: node packager.js
 */

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { execSync } = require('child_process');

console.log('--- Starting OmniPortal Native Packager ---');

// 1. Create temporary package.json
const packageJson = {
  name: "omniportal-native",
  version: "1.0.0",
  main: "main.js",
  scripts: {
    start: "electron ."
  }
};
fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(packageJson, null, 2));

// 2. Create Electron main.js file
const mainJs = \`
const { app, BrowserWindow } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');

function createWindow () {
  const win = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1200,
    height: 800,
    title: "OmniPortal Desktop Workspace",
    icon: path.join(__dirname, 'icon.png'),
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: false,
      contextIsolation: true
    }
  });

  win.loadFile('OmniPortal-Quine-Workspace.html');
  win.setMenu(null); // Hide menu bar for native feel
}

app.whenReady().then(() => {
  createWindow();

  app.on('activate', () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) createWindow();
  });
});

app.on('window-all-closed', () => {
  if (process.platform !== 'darwin') app.quit();
});
\`;
fs.writeFileSync('main.js', mainJs);

console.log('Created main.js and package.json configuration.');
console.log('Now building native executables using electron-packager...');

try {
  execSync('npx electron-packager . OmniPortal --platform=all --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite', { stdio: 'inherit' });
  console.log('\\nSUCCESS! Native binaries built inside the "dist/" folder.');
} catch (e) {
  console.log('\\nElectron packager failed. You can run the app locally using: "npm start"');
}
